purpose: Phase-6C population-response evidence records. The frozen Profile-B package contains NO population-level apoptosis dataset (no apoptotic fraction, no viable/apoptotic accounting, no cellularity). Every record here is therefore qualitative and carries citation NOT_REPORTED; population relationships are LABELLED PREDICTIONS derived from single-cell evidence, never experimental population facts.

pop_b16bl6_transfer.citation: NOT_REPORTED (population apoptotic-fraction dataset not reported; derived from the single-cell B16 -> B16BL6 apoptosis transfer)
supports: population composition evolves as the single-cell apoptosis trajectory progresses (qualitative)
pop_b16bl6_transfer.note: Population echo of the Phase-6B context transfer; schematic only.

pop_b16_mech.citation: NOT_REPORTED (single-cell apoptosis mechanism grounded in B16; population-level accounting not reported)
supports: a susceptible sub-population accumulates apoptosis while a resistant fraction persists (qualitative)

pop_b16f10_mech.citation: NOT_REPORTED (single-cell apoptosis mechanism grounded in B16-F10; population-level accounting not reported)
supports: a susceptible sub-population accumulates apoptosis while a resistant fraction persists (qualitative)
pop_b16f10_mech.note: Mechanistic prediction; kept separate from B16; schematic fractions only.

pop_transfer_b16_to_b16bl6.rationale: The population composition for the canonical B16BL6 line inherits the single-cell mechanism transferred from B16 in Phase 6B; no direct B16BL6 population dataset exists.

integrity_rules.no_fabricated_counts: No record may state a cell count, density, cellularity, apoptotic index, or biological %.
integrity_rules.prediction_never_experimental: Population relationships are labelled predictions; none is presented as experimental.
integrity_rules.not_reported_stays: Absent population data stays NOT_REPORTED; it is never upgraded to a measurement.
